children: US Solana treasury and consumer brands owner's fiscal 2026 revenue rose yr/yr, driven by digital asset revenue
Net loss widened to $246.1 mln, mainly due to $195.1 mln unrealized losses on digital assets
Company repurchased 2.9 mln shares and retired $19.5 mln in secured convertible note debt
Upexi expects staking revenue to exceed ongoing cash operating expenses beginning in the current quarter
SOLANA TREASURY STRATEGY - Co said fiscal 2026 marked first full year of Solana treasury strategy, driving digital asset revenue
UNREALIZED LOSSES - Net loss widened mainly due to $195.1 mln unrealized losses on digital assets
EFFICIENCY INITIATIVE - Co completed efficiency initiative and expects staking revenue to exceed ongoing cash operating expenses beginning with current quarter
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the personal products peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Upexi, Inc is $4.65, about 342.9% above its September 16 closing price of $1.05
